t.Every API conversation has two sides. Th: Kowace tattaunawar API tana da bangarori biyu. Tambayar ita ce ake kira buƙatun kuma ana kiran amsar amsa. Kusan kowane API ɗin gidan yanar gizo na zamani yana amfani da HTTP, harshe ɗaya da mai binciken ku ke amfani da shi don loda shafukan yanar gizo, yawanci a cikin amintaccen tsari, HTTPS.
